Coram:
 Hon'Ble Mr. Justice Anish Dayal
 Order

This petition has been filed for quashing of FIR No.132/2021 under Sections 498A/406/34 IPC PS Roop Nagar, Delhi-07 on the ground that the parties have settled their disputes vide memorandum of understanding dated 23rd December, 2021.
The petitioner Nos.1-4 & 6 as well as respondent No.2/complainant are present in Court and are duly identified by their respective counsels and the Investigating Officer.

As per the settlement, a balance amount of Rs.3,00,000/- is to be paid to the respondent No.2 at the stage which is being tendered vide DD No.501881 drawn on Canara Bank to the respondent No.2 who has duly received and acknowledged it.
The petitioner No.1 and respondent No.2 were married on 12th October, 2016 but due to disputes and difference the marriage has now ended in a divorce vide decree dated 18th April, 2022.
No child was born out of their wedlock.

2. Considering the above settlement between the parties and chances of conviction of the petitioners being remote and bleak, there is no use to continue with proceedings of the present FIR as the complainant has settled all disputes with the petitioner.
Accordingly, the petition is allowed.
Consequently, the FIR No.132/2021 under Sections 498A/406/34 IPC PS Roop Nagar, Delhi-07 and proceedings emanating therefrom are quashed.
3. Parties shall abide by the terms of settlement.
4. Accordingly, the petition is disposed of.
Pending applications (if any) are disposed of as infructuous.
